messages.subject: Executive candidate | Saudi Arabia, GCC and international leadership mandates
messages.body:
Dear Recruit Talent Team,

I am contacting the current email published on your website after the earlier info@recruit-talent.com address returned a server-unavailable error.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My 12+ year career spans multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. My current remit covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and cross-functional delivery.

I am pursuing senior Saudi Arabia, GCC and wider international mandates across Country Director, Country Representative, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Strategic Partnerships and related leadership roles. I bring direct operating experience from a major industrial environment, including energy-transition stakeholder work, carbon-data governance and senior engagement with ministries, regulators and communities.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate assignments and available following a 30-day notice period. Employer-supported work authorization is required where applicable.

My attached CV is tailored to this search profile. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates and a confidential discussion with the appropriate senior recruiter.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
